eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Owyhee, ID; at 7:38 PM on AUG 8, 2026 Effective until 9:38 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Owyhee County has issued a civil emergency Level 2 Set Alert for the five miles surrounding Big Springs Road Owyhee River Canyon to Dickshooter then south to the 45 Ranch. Contact Owyhee County at 2 0 8 4 9 5 1 2 0 5 for more information. This message was sent by the Idaho State Communications Center and is now concluded.
